```{r}

library(ggplot2)
library(Rmisc)
library(readxl)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
source("path/to/Kinematics methods.R")

```

```{r}

output_dir = "/output/directory/"

```

```{r}

#cx.shi.full is generated in the notebook for the gigure 3 files..
PFN.shi = cx.shi.full[grep("Empty|PFNa|PFNd|PFNv",names(cx.shi.full))]

```

```{r}

exp.length = 32.63 * 15

start.frame = 6700

end.frame = start.frame + exp.length -1

PFNd.31c.plots = colored_path_plot(cx.shi.full$`PFNd 31C Counterclockwise 03`,1,c("Driver","Temperature","Stimulus","Replicate"),start.frame,end.frame)

PFNd.31c.plots[[3]]

start.frame = 9900
end.frame = start.frame + exp.length -1

PFNd.21c.plots = colored_path_plot(cx.shi.full$`PFNd 21C Counterclockwise 06`,1,c("Driver","Temperature","Stimulus","Replicate"),start.frame,end.frame)

PFNd.21c.plots[[3]]

```

```{r}

PFN.bouts = per_bouts_matrix(PFN.shi,c("Driver","Temperature","Stimulus","Replicate"),1,10*60*32.63,30)
PFN.bouts.summary = bouts_matrix(PFN.shi,c("Driver","Temperature","Stimulus","Replicate"),1,10*60*32.63,30)

```

```{r}

PFN.bouts.corrected = PFN.bouts
PFN.bouts.corrected$mean_ang_vel[which(PFN.bouts.corrected$Stimulus == "Clockwise")] = -PFN.bouts.corrected$mean_ang_vel[which(PFN.bouts.corrected$Stimulus == "Clockwise")]

PFN.bouts.31 = PFN.bouts.corrected[grep("31C",PFN.bouts.corrected$Temperature),]
PFN.bouts.21 = PFN.bouts.corrected[grep("21C",PFN.bouts.corrected$Temperature),]


PFN.bouts.summary.corrected = PFN.bouts.summary
PFN.bouts.summary.corrected$mean_ang_vel[which(PFN.bouts.summary.corrected$Stimulus == "Clockwise")] = -PFN.bouts.summary.corrected$mean_ang_vel[which(PFN.bouts.summary.corrected$Stimulus == "Clockwise")]

PFN.bouts.summary.corrected = PFN.bouts.summary
PFN.bouts.summary.corrected$mean_ang_vel[which(PFN.bouts.summary.corrected$Stimulus == "Clockwise")] = -PFN.bouts.summary.corrected$mean_ang_vel[which(PFN.bouts.summary.corrected$Stimulus == "Clockwise")]

PFN.bouts.summary.corrected$curvature[which(PFN.bouts.summary.corrected$Stimulus == "Clockwise")] = -PFN.bouts.summary.corrected$curvature[which(PFN.bouts.summary.corrected$Stimulus == "Clockwise")]

PFN.bouts.summary.31 = PFN.bouts.summary.corrected[grep("31C",PFN.bouts.summary.corrected$Temperature),]


```

```{r}

x = PFN.bouts.summary.corrected  %>%
  mutate(Driver=factor(Driver, levels = c("Empty","PFNa","PFNv","PFNd")) )

pfn.ang.box = ggplot(x, aes(x = Driver, fill = Temperature, y = mean_ang_vel))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  geom_point(aes(fill = Temperature), size = 1, shape = 21, position = position_jitterdodge())+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#8491B450","#d1495b"))+
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(axis.line.y = element_line(size=1,linetype = "solid"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(face="bold",size=15),
        axis.text.x = element_text(face="bold",size=15))

pfn.ang.var.box = ggplot(x, aes(x = Driver, fill = Temperature, y = ang_var))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  geom_point(aes(fill = Temperature), size = 1, shape = 21, position = position_jitterdodge())+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#8491B450","#d1495b"))+
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(axis.line.y = element_line(size=1,linetype = "solid"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(face="bold",size=15),
        axis.text.x = element_text(face="bold",size=15))




setwd(output_dir)

ggsave(filename = "PFN angular velocity boxplot.svg", plot = pfn.ang.box, width = 4,height = 4)
ggsave(filename = "PFN translational velocity boxplot.svg", plot = pfn.trans.box, width = 4,height = 4)
ggsave(filename = "PFN angular variance boxplot.svg", plot = pfn.ang.var.box, width = 4,height = 4)


```


```{r}

pfn.timecourse = timecourse_matrix_per_bout(PFN.shi,c("Driver","Temperature","Stimulus","Replicate"),1,10*60*32.63,30)

pfn.timecourse$ang_vel[which(pfn.timecourse$Stimulus == "Clockwise")] = -pfn.timecourse$ang_vel[which(pfn.timecourse$Stimulus == "Clockwise")] 

```

```{r}

pfn.timecourse.summary = summarySE(data = pfn.timecourse,
                                   measurevar = "ang_vel",
                                   groupvars = c("Driver","Temperature","time"),
                                   na.rm = TRUE)

pfn.timecourse.summary = pfn.timecourse.summary[which(pfn.timecourse.summary$N>10),]


pfn.timecourse.summary.31 = subset(pfn.timecourse.summary,subset = Temperature == "31C")
pfn.timecourse.summary.21 = subset(pfn.timecourse.summary,subset = Temperature == "21C")

```

```{r}

var.over.time.31 = ggplot(pfn.timecourse.summary.31, aes(x = time,y=sd*sd,color = Driver))+
  geom_line()+
  theme_minimal()+
  scale_x_continuous(trans='log10')

var.over.time.21 = ggplot(pfn.timecourse.summary.21, aes(x = time,y=sd*sd,color = Driver))+
  geom_line()+
  theme_minimal()+
  scale_x_continuous(trans='log10')

var.over.time.31


setwd(output_dir)

ggsave(filename = "PFN 21 variance over time.svg", plot = var.over.time.21, width = 4,height = 4)
ggsave(filename = "PFN 31 variance over time.svg", plot = var.over.time.31, width = 4,height = 4)

```

pfnd.vs.wt.duration.hist =  ggplot(pfnd.bouts.31, aes(x = bout_duration, fill = Driver))+

```{r}

#15 secs of walking
empty.31c.path.data = timecourse.data.from.list(cx.shi.full$`Empty 31C Counterclockwise 09`,1,c("Driver","Temperature","Stimulus","Replicate"))

length.to.plot = 15*32.63

start.frame = 6500
end.frame = start.frame+length.to.plot-1

empty.31c.path.data = empty.31c.path.data[c(start.frame:end.frame),]

ang.max.31 = max(abs(empty.31c.path.data$angular_velocity),na.rm = TRUE)
empty.31c.path.data$translational_velocity = empty.31c.path.data$translational_velocity/max( empty.31c.path.data$translational_velocity,na.rm = TRUE)



empty.31.ang.path = ggplot(empty.31c.path.data,aes(x=x,y=y,color=angular_velocity))+
  geom_path(size=1)+
  scale_color_scico(palette = "romaO",limits = c(-ang.max.31,ang.max.31))+
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1)+
  #ylim(c(0,ymax))+
  #xlim(c(0,xmax))+
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.line.y = element_line(size=1,linetype = "solid"),
        axis.line.x = element_line(size=1,linetype = "solid"),
        axis.ticks = element_line(size=1,linetype = "solid"))

empty.31.trans.path = ggplot(empty.31c.path.data,aes(x=x,y=y,color=translational_velocity))+
  geom_path(size=1)+
  scale_color_scico(palette = "romaO",begin=0.5,end=1)+
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1)+ 
  #ylim(0,ymax)+
  #xlim(0,xmax)+
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.line.y = element_line(size=1,linetype = "solid"),
        axis.line.x = element_line(size=1,linetype = "solid"),
        axis.ticks = element_line(size=1,linetype = "solid"))



```

```{r}


#31c
empty.31c.lineplot.data = rbind(empty.31c.path.data,empty.31c.path.data)
empty.31c.lineplot.data$angular_velocity = empty.31c.lineplot.data$angular_velocity/ang.max.31
empty.31c.lineplot.data$Velocity = c(empty.31c.path.data$translational_velocity,
                                    empty.31c.path.data$angular_velocity/ang.max.31)
empty.31c.lineplot.data$Velocity_type = c(rep("Translational",nrow(empty.31c.path.data)),
                                         rep("Angular",nrow(empty.31c.path.data)))
empty.31c.lineplot.data$Time = c(c(1:nrow(empty.31c.path.data))/32.63,
                                c(1:nrow(empty.31c.path.data))/32.63)

```

```{r}

empty.31.vel.lineplot = ggplot(empty.31c.lineplot.data,aes(x=Time,y=Velocity,color=Velocity_type))+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0,linetype = "dashed",alpha =1,col= "black",size=1)+
  geom_line(size=1)+
  theme_minimal()+
  #ylim(c(-1,1))+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#f194a3","#45ada8"))+
  theme(axis.line.y = element_line(size=1,linetype = "solid"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(face="bold",size=15),
        axis.text.x = element_text(face="bold",size=15))

```
